{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for sentinel age (-1) in converted customers
num_sentinel = (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
num_valid = len(converted_df) - num_sentinel
mean_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with age = -1: {num_sentinel}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {num_valid}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")
print(f"Rounded mean age: {mean_age:.2f}")"}
